news.title: An alarmed bond market gets the Trump administration to act again
news.summary: Normally quiet, the bond market can occasionally send warning signals loud enough to hit stock markets worldwide and even grab the attention of U.S. presidents and other world leaders.  After the bond market’s alarm bells rose in volume through the summer, the Trump administration announced on Wednesday a move that could help calm it down.  The U.S. Treasury Department said it will more than double the amount of U.S. government bonds that it will buy back, and the move worked in getting longer-term yields lower, for now at least.

news.title: Gold Prices Pop After Treasury Moves to Push Down Bond Yields
news.summary: Precious metals prices jumped, pushing gold to its highest settlement value since Mary 29, after the Treasury Department said it would ramp up buybacks of longer-dated government debt. Treasury's move at least momentarily reversed a run-up in bond yields that had been pressuring precious metals, which pay no yield.

news.title: U.S. Stocks Climb as Bond Yields Dive
news.summary: STOCKS  U.S. government bond yields are sliding after the Treasury Department said it would ramp up bond repurchases.
